fields.summary: Guest enquiries — contact form, rooms catalogue and messages API

content.text: Guests of the B&B currently phone or e-mail with questions, and enquiries get lost. This story delivers a self-service
on the public home page, backed by a
. Staff read enquiries through an authenticated admin API. The public
(UI and API) must stay consistent, because guests often ask about a room they have just looked at.
, I want to send the B&B a message from the home page, so that I can ask about my stay without phoning.
, I want to see which rooms exist and what they cost per night, so that I can ask about a specific room.
, I want to read guest enquiries through an authenticated API, so that no personal data is exposed publicly.
the contact form (home page, section "Send Us a Message"), the rooms list on the home page ("Our Rooms"), and the endpoints listed under API contract.
room booking/reservation, the admin UI screens, e-mail notifications, payment, and CAPTCHA/rate limiting (tracked in DEMO-230).
